{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check how many rows have raw string 'revenue' == '999999.99'
raw_test_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()

# Check how many rows have numeric revenue == 999999.99
numeric_test_count = (df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum()

# Print both counts
print(f"Raw string count (revenue == '999999.99'):", raw_test_count)
print(f"Numeric count (revenue_numeric == 999999.99):", numeric_test_count)"}
